THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.482 CR.P.C PRAYING TO QUASH THE FIR REGISTERED IN CR.NO.179/2021 OF BASAVANAGUDI WOMEN P.S., FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 498A, 506 OF IPC AND SEC.3, 4 OF D.P ACT ON THE FILE OF THE 37TH ACMM, NRUPATUNGA ROAD,
BANGALORE IN SO FAR AS THE PETITIONERS ARE CONCERNED.
 THIS CRL.P, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS JUSTICE M G UMA  ORAL ORDER
The petitioners and respondent No.2 are present before the Court and they are identified by their respective counsel.

2. The petitioners and respondent No.2 have filed the compromise petition under Section 320 read with Section 482 of Cr.PC along with the joint affidavit which reads as under:
"WE, 1) Smt. K. Mahalakshmi, W/o. Late Sri. K.S. Prakash.

Aged about 62 years Smt.
Madhuri K., W/o. Karibandi Seetaramayya, Aged about 42 years, both are R/at.
No.688, 10% A Main, Jayanagar, 4th Block, Bengaluru South, Bengaluru 560 011 3)

Smt. R.D.M. Priyadarshini, W/o. Krishna Kishore Kalluri, Aged about 38 years, R/a.
Door No. 50, C Street Fort, Near Vani Vilas Hospital, NC: 2025:KHC:1076 Bengaluru 560002, do hereby solemnly affirm and state as follows:
(Defacto Complainant) in the above petition.
We know the facts of the case.

2. We state that the respondent No.2 has lodged a complaint dated 29.09.2021 before the respondent No.1 police which came to be registered as Crime No.179/2021 pending on the file of 37th ACMM At Bangalore by the respondent No.1, for the offences punishable under sections 498A, 506, of IPC and Section 3 and 4 of DP Act.
Petitioners are mother in law and Sister in law of the 2nd respondent.

sentences.text: We state that subsequent to filling of said complaint the 2nd respondent filed MC No. 2156/2022 for divorce against her husband before the 1st Additional Family Court At Bangalore.

The petitioners and 2nd respondent at the intervention of well-wishers and family members, 2nd respondent and her husband filed joint memo before the family court and reunite the family and agreed to withdraw all the pending cases each others as per the terms mentioned in the joint memo.

The copy of the joint memo filed before family court in MC No. 2156/2022 is enclosed along with this application."
NC: 2025:KHC:1076 3.
The petitioners and respondent No.2 who have sworn to the affidavit admit the contents of the same.
Respondent No.2 specifically stated that, she has withdrawn the allegations and the complaint made against the petitioners and she has no objection to allow the petition.
It is also stated that the husband and wife are re-united at the instance of well- wishers and they are residing together.
Under such circumstances, respondent No.2 is withdrawing the complaint.
4. Submission is placed on record.
Satisfied with the terms of compromise petition.
The parties are permitted to compound the offences.

5. Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER (i) The petition is allowed.

(ii) The FIR registered in Crime No.179/2021 of Basavangudi Women Police Station,
pending on the file of the learned 37th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Bengaluru City, for the offences punishable under Sections NC:
2025:KHC:1076 498A, 506 of Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, is hereby quashed.
